integrity: The proof is symbolic for all integer dimensions at least two; exact rational finite computations check representative dimensions but do not establish the infinite theorem. Independently reproduced computational checks are not claimed. Self-review alone has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The optimal value and existence of an equal-edge optimum are consequences of earlier edge-transitive fastest-mixing theory and are not claimed as independently novel. The new assertions concern the sharp uniqueness transition, rowwise rigidity for unrestricted optima, and the local dimension of translation-invariant optimal allocations. The older Karlin–Lindqvist–Yao 1993 paper was available only through an abstract, so historical novelty retains specific coverage uncertainty. Nonreversible chains, moves beyond distance two, and complete classification of all vertex-dependent optimal allocations are outside scope.
title: A sharp rigidity transition and optimal-face dimension for two-hop hypercube walks
